product_one_liner.value: Formalize provides a compliance and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform that helps organizations manage and automate regulatory compliance, risk, controls, policies, and related workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Summarizes the company’s own platform description.

pricing_page.notes: The page describes a free trial and paid plans offered by quote.

named_customers.notes: The public case-study index surfaced one customer, Arcano Partners, but no second customer name. Per the instructions, the list is empty when the available customer evidence shows fewer than two names.

employee_band.notes: Formalize’s LinkedIn company page gives the company size as 201–500 employees. Its own About page separately says 160+ employees; the cited LinkedIn band is the requested band.

hq_location.notes: Formalize’s careers page calls its Copenhagen office the headquarters, and LinkedIn lists Copenhagen as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The careers page identifies the company as founded in 2021; the 2025 funding announcement also describes Formalize as founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is a compliance/news and analysis blog; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center has multiple product documentation collections and dozens of articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists openings, but none has AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision in its title.

model_provider.notes: Checked the public product help center, blog, security information, privacy policy, and linked Trust Center; no public statement identifying the product’s AI model or provider was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The Formalize security page names ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. The security page for Whistleblower Software by Formalize describes GDPR audits/compliance. ISAE 3000 was omitted because it is not one of the requested categories.

last_funding.notes: The Series B was announced on 2025-10-28 as €30 million; Seedtable reports the round as $35.0 million USD.

raised_18mo.notes: Formalize announced its Series B on 2025-10-28, within the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists a Sales Development Representative - Norway opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The 2026-09-02 post announces the Formalize Marketplace and its launch with compliance blueprints, within the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP join/departure announcement or sufficiently complete team page was located to support either a positive or a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The current public job postings are readable, but none names a CRM or sales/marketing system.
